notes: suite: CoreX-scoped: LibTorch-free CUDA tensor-kernel compilation (10 TUs) + self-contained on-GPU smoke (6 checks). The repository's own gtest/ctest suite (200+ files) requires the full vcpkg application build (imgui/sdl3/vulkan/usd/ffmpeg/openimageio/python/glm/spdlog/tbb/gtest) and the host lfs_core memory-pool/error infrastructure, which is not buildable on this headless CoreX node; see session_notes.md for scope justification.
